Cyclad.description: Developed a centralized testing platform for a complex ecosystem of credit and insurance reporting systems. The solution replaced a fragmented set of legacy tools, including Ranorex, Postman, SpecFlow, and custom Java-based frameworks, with a unified C# testing ecosystem. The desktop application enables manual QA engineers to execute Web UI and API regression test suites with minimal programming expertise, while ensuring seamless integration with automated CI/CD pipelines. This significantly improved test consistency, maintainability, and overall testing efficiency across multiple systems, reducing regression testing from a multi-day effort requiring several testers to a fully automated process that that produces reliable results within 3 hours.
responsibilities: Developed automated web UI and API tests, from zero to full scope coverage of core features, which reduced regression testing from a multi-day effort requiring several testers to a fully automated process that that produces reliable results within hours
Developed and maintaining an in-house desktop testing application used by QA teams to execute automated test scenarios, replacing a complex web of several legacy tools
Designed and implemented a scalable, layered test automation architecture from scratch, including reusable frameworks, libraries, and testing components
Created and maintained databases for test user credentials and test data management
Collected and archived test execution metrics, automation usage statistics and test results
Implemented JSON-based configuration management and prepared manuals for non-technical users
Collaborated within an Agile, self-organizing team environment, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives and delivery planning
Developed and maintained automated Web UI and API regression test suites, expanding scope coverage from zero to full validation of critical business processes

Striped Giraffe.description: Developed bespoke solutions for clients utilizing SAP systems, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams across multiple countries and external partners such as Accenture.
responsibilities: Executed functional Web UI tests of bespoke modifications within SAP Hybris platform
Designed and developed automated test solutions for end-to-end business processes and data flow validation
Reviewed and analyzed system requirements and technical specifications
Prepared and maintained test data, test cases, documentation, test execution reports and end-user manuals
Performed root cause analysis and issue resolution
Mentored a fellow QA Specialist in test automation practices, supporting their transition from manual to automated testing

Webanywhere.role: QA Team Leader, Quality Assurance Specialist
Webanywhere.description: Created web-based platforms for schools and educational institutions, developing new tailored solutions and enhancing existing e-learning systems.
stack: Selenium IDE, Selenium WebDriver, Java, Redmine, TestLink, Moodle, Totara
responsibilities: Performed functional Web UI tests of CMS tools, bespoke modifications for the Totara/Moodle system and cross-system integrations with Capita SIMS
Validated the security and confidentiality of sensitive personal data processed within tested systems
Designed and developed an automated functional Web UI and performance test suites
Managed and mentored a team of QA Specialists (3-5 FTE) across multiple projects
Tested implementations interacting across multiple time zones with highly time-specific events, handling high user traffic and large-scale databases (1mln overall and up to 100k concurrent users)
Led the transition from manual to automated testing by defining automation strategy, implementing a test automation framework from scratch and mentoring other QA
